High-level options (rough numbers, subject to legal/finance sign-off):

A) Tranche + Annualize Option
- Add 175M tokens as a mid-term top-up, prorated for remaining term (estimate: 5 months left => ~29% of annual price)

B) Tranche + SLA-credit structure (preferred for risk share)
- Add tranche at standard prorated rate, no upfront annualize discount
- SLA credits: for any calendar month where p99 request latency exceeds 350ms or availability < 99.5%, provide token-credit refunds scaled to minutes of violation (example table in attachment)
- If SLA triggers >2 months in the 5-month period, automatic review + one-time service credit equal to 15% of that month's tranche spend

I'll attach a starter quote and an SLA-credit term sheet for transparency.
